{{Spoiler}}

'''Pickled warped fungus''' is the secret preservation of the [[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]]: a splash potion of {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} lasting 5 minutes, without particles.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_warped_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Warped fungus, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. The recipe is secret; making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''

== Usage ==

=== Throwing ===
It can't be eaten. Like a splash potion, it is thrown and applies Invisibility for up to 5:00 to every creature in the splash, at full duration for a direct hit and shorter further out. The tooltip marks it as throwable.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Pickled warped fungus became throwable.}}
